submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, Mg0.80Mn0.20 (index 14) gave the highest photocurrent: 7e-8 A. The other two gave 1e-8 A (Mn-rich, index 2) and 0 A (Mg0.33 spinel-like, index 12). XRD of index 14 shows the main 2.784 1/A phase plus an extra peak at 3.003 1/A that looks like MgO rocksalt. That points to a two-phase mixture that the other scanned compositions (indices 20 and 6) don't have.

rejected.reason: Measured photocurrent was 1e-8 A, 7x lower than index 14
XRD shows a single phase with no MgO-like secondary peak; merit not measured
